name: Cambridge Beaches Resort & Spa
insider_take: This intimate 30-acre peninsula resort sits on Bermuda's longest stretch of private pink sand beaches, where you can literally walk from one pristine cove to another without ever leaving the property.
whats_special: Cambridge Beaches boasts four distinct pink sand beaches and five secluded coves, making it the only resort in Bermuda with such diverse coastal access. The property's historic cottage-style accommodations date back to the 1920s, and it's perfectly positioned to catch both sunrise and sunset views from different vantage points across the peninsula.
pro_tip: Book a treatment at the Ocean House Spa during low tide – the glass-walled treatment rooms offer unobstructed views of the coral reefs and you can watch tropical fish swimming just feet away.
dont_miss: The Royal Naval Dockyard is just minutes away, featuring the National Museum of Bermuda housed in a 19th-century fortress, plus duty-free shopping and local craft markets. Also explore the nearby Somerset Bridge – the world's smallest drawbridge that opens just 18 inches to let sailboat masts pass through.
pros: Historic charm with multiple private pink sand beaches
Intimate cottage-style accommodations with ocean views
Prime location in Bermuda's stunning Sandys Parish
cons: Remote location requires transportation for off-property activities
Higher price point for luxury resort experience
